title: Unit 5 第二课时 基础达标与综合拓展

sections.title: I. 根据句意用 can 或 can't 完成句子
sections.instruction: 根据句意用 can 或 can't 完成句子

questions.prompt: I ______ sing very well, so I want to join the music club.
questions.translation: 我唱得很好，所以我想加入音乐俱乐部。
questions.explanation: 根据后文“我想加入音乐俱乐部”可知，此处表示会唱歌，故填 can。

questions.prompt: A fish ______ live without water.
questions.translation: 鱼离开水不能活。
questions.explanation: 常识可知鱼离不开水，故填 can't。

questions.prompt: Henry has a parrot. It ______ speak.
questions.translation: 亨利有一只鹦鹉。它会说话。
questions.explanation: 鹦鹉是一种会学说话的鸟，故填 can。

questions.prompt: Alice ______ play the piano. She wants to be a pianist.
questions.translation: 爱丽丝会弹钢琴。她想成为一名钢琴家。
questions.explanation: 想成为钢琴家说明她会弹钢琴，故填 can。

questions.prompt: Judy and Tom ______ join the drama club because they don't have time.
questions.translation: 朱迪和汤姆不能加入戏剧俱乐部，因为他们没有时间。
questions.explanation: 根据“因为他们没有时间”可知，他们不能加入俱乐部，故填 can't。

sections.title: II. 根据表格内容，用 can 或 can't 填空
sections.instruction:
根据表格内容，用 can 或 can't 填空 [HTML:
Namedraw picturesread with feelingswimspeak English
Peter√√××
Liu Fang××√√
Ms. Gao×√√×
]

questions.prompt: Peter is my friend. He ______ draw pictures and read with feeling. But he ______ swim.
questions.translation: 彼得是我的朋友。他会画画和有感情地朗读。但他不会游泳。
questions.explanation: 根据表格，Peter画画和有感情朗读均为√，游泳为×，故填 can; can't。

questions.prompt: Liu Fang is my classmate. She ______ speak English.
questions.translation: 刘芳是我的同班同学。她会说英语。
questions.explanation: 根据表格，Liu Fang说英语为√，故填 can。

questions.prompt: Both Liu Fang and Ms. Gao ______ swim.
questions.translation: 刘芳和高老师都会游泳。
questions.explanation: 根据表格，Liu Fang和Ms. Gao的游泳项均为√，故填 can。

questions.prompt: Ms. Gao ______ draw pictures or speak English. She is our P.E. teacher.
questions.translation: 高老师不会画画也不会说英语。她是我们的体育老师。
questions.explanation: 根据表格，Ms. Gao的画画和说英语项均为×，故填 can't。

sections.title: III. 用所给词的适当形式填空
sections.instruction: 用所给词的适当形式填空
sections.passage: We do a survey (调查) about [1] (ability) in our class. Here [2] (be) the results. Linda and Judy are my friends. They can play the violin. They learn to play it every Saturday. Linda can [3] (also) play the piano but Judy [4] (can). My classmate Tom thinks speaking English is easy, so he is good at [5] (speak) English. He also helps us with English. As for me, I can cook in my free time. I think it is happy to cook for my family.

questions.prompt: 1. (ability)
questions.translation: 我们在班里做了一个关于各项能力的调查。
questions.explanation: 介词 about 后接名词复数 abilities，意为“各项能力”，故选 abilities。

questions.translation: 以下是调查结果。
questions.explanation: here 引导的倒装句，主语 the results 是复数，一般现在时 be 动词用 are，故选 are。

questions.prompt: 3. (also)
questions.translation: 琳达还会弹钢琴。
questions.explanation: 放在情态动词 can 之后、行为动词 play 之前，表示“也”，用 also，故选 also。

questions.prompt: 4. (can)
questions.translation: 但朱迪不会。
questions.explanation: but 表示转折，前句是肯定句 Linda can also play...，后半句表示否定但朱迪不会，省略为 Judy can't，故选 can't。

questions.prompt: 5. (speak)
questions.translation: 所以他擅长说英语。
questions.explanation: be good at doing sth. 擅长做某事，介词 at 后接动名词 speaking，故选 speaking。

sections.title: IV. 阅读理解
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，选择最佳选项
sections.passage: There are many clubs in our school. My English is not good. I want to join the English club. Liu Ying wants to learn to draw, so she wants to join the art club. Deng Hui likes running. He wants to join the sports club. Judy is good at singing and she wants to join the music club. What club does Han Meimei want to join? Oh, she likes eating and she wants to join the cooking club.

questions.prompt: The writer's ________ is not good according to this passage.
questions.translation: 根据这篇文章，作者的什么不好？
questions.explanation: 故选 English。根据文章“My English is not good.”可知作者的英语不好。

questions.prompt: Liu Ying wants to join the ________ club.
questions.translation: 刘莹想加入什么俱乐部？
questions.explanation: 故选 art。根据“Liu Ying wants to learn to draw, so she wants to join the art club.”可知她想加入美术俱乐部。

questions.prompt: Who wants to join the sports club?
questions.translation: 谁想加入体育俱乐部？
questions.explanation: 故选 Deng Hui.。根据“Deng Hui likes running. He wants to join the sports club.”可知是邓辉。

questions.prompt: Judy ________ very well.
questions.translation: 朱迪唱歌......非常好。
questions.explanation: 故选 sings。根据“Judy is good at singing”可知她唱歌很好。

questions.prompt: Han Meimei enjoys ________.
questions.translation: 韩梅梅喜欢......
questions.explanation: 故选 eating。根据“Oh, she likes eating and she wants to join the cooking club.”可知她喜欢吃。

sections.title: V. 语法选择
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文，按照句子结构的语法性和上下文连贯的要求，从各小题所给的A、B、C三个选项中选出一个最佳答案。
sections.passage:
Many Chinese children like playing the piano. [1] you play the piano? It can be an easy hobby because you can find a good teacher [2]. It can also be difficult because you need [3] it every day. So how can you play the piano well? Here [4] some ideas.
First, you need a piano [5] your home or school. So you can play it at any time. Second, you need a good teacher at the beginning. [6] good teacher will help you play better in a short time. They can also help you with [7]. Third, you need time. It may take ten years to become a good pianist (钢琴家). If you love it, you can play better.
It's not easy to play the piano but [8] can be interesting. You can play it when you feel happy or sad. You can also play it with your friends [9] family when you get together on holidays. It can [10] great fun.

questions.translation: 你会弹钢琴吗？
questions.explanation: 故选 Can。根据下文“how can you play the piano well?”以及情态动词表能力的用法，此处询问“你会弹钢琴吗”。

questions.translation: 你可以很容易地找到一个好老师。
questions.explanation: 故选 easily。修饰动词 find 应用副词 easily。

questions.translation: 因为你需要每天弹奏它。
questions.explanation: 故选 to play。need to do sth. 为固定搭配，意为“需要做某事”。

questions.translation: 这里有一些主意。
questions.explanation: 故选 are。some ideas 是复数主语，谓语动词用 are。

questions.translation: 首先，你需要在你的家或学校有一架钢琴。
questions.explanation: 故选 at。at home 或 at school 是固定介词短语。

questions.translation: 一位好老师会帮你...
questions.explanation: 故选 A。此处泛指上文提到的“一个好老师”，且 good 以辅音音素开头，用不定冠词 A。

questions.translation: 他们也能帮你解决问题。
questions.explanation: 故选 problems。help sb. with sth. 中 sth. 通常用名词复数表泛指。

questions.translation: 弹钢琴不容易但它很有趣。
questions.explanation: 故选 it。代指前面的动名词短语 playing the piano，用单数代词 it。

questions.translation: 你也可以在节日聚会时和你的朋友或家人一起弹。
questions.explanation: 故选 or。friends 与 family 是并列选择关系，在肯定句中用 or。

questions.translation: 它能带来极大的乐趣。
questions.explanation: 故选 bring。情态动词 can 后接动词原形 bring。

sections.title: VI. (2025·眉山) 阅读理解
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，选择最佳选项
sections.passage:
Pink Lily
We are looking to add some food servers to our team. Pink Lily is a 5-star Restaurant. We are searching for friendly and energetic people to join us!

Requirements
1. Team spirit is needed.
2. Some weekend availability is required.
3. No experience is OK. We will provide you with training.
4. Part-time positions are open to teens between 16 and 18 years old.

Salary
$50-$80 a day;
Full-time workers can get $5-$10 more a day.

Address
34 S Windsor St.

How to apply
We will take applications online at www.pinklily.com from June 15 to June 30, 2025.
We look forward to meeting you soon!

questions.prompt: What is the restaurant looking for?
questions.translation: 这家餐馆在寻找什么人？
questions.explanation: 故选 Servers.。根据文章“We are looking to add some food servers to our team.”可知是在寻找服务员。

questions.prompt: What is needed for the position?
options: Ability to work as part of a team.
questions.translation: 这个职位需要什么条件？
questions.explanation: 故选 Ability to work as part of a team.。根据Requirements中的“1. Team spirit is needed.”可知需要团队合作精神。

questions.prompt: How much can Linda make at most a day if she works full time?
questions.translation: 如果琳达全职工作，她一天最多能赚多少钱？
questions.explanation: 故选 $90.。根据“Salary: $50-$80 a day; Full-time workers can get $5-$10 more a day.”可知全职一天最多可赚 $80 + $10 = $90。
